## Checklist

- [ ] Readings are in Turkish spelling, lowercase, without suffixes
- [ ] A test covers each new reading or fix
- [ ] `docs/pronunciation.md` matches the code
- [ ] `cargo fmt`, `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings` and `cargo test` pass
- [ ] I listened to the result (optional, but helps)
